# NextReach Studio — AI Context

NextReach Studio is a founder-led, senior-engineered software development studio based in Pune, India. We build custom web applications, AI workflow automation, internal tools, and rapid MVPs for SMBs and startups under fixed-scope, one-time-price contracts. Direct senior developer access. Bi-weekly sprint delivery.

## Services

- Custom Web Applications & SaaS Portals — Database-driven platforms, admin panels, customer portals. 4–8 week delivery.
- Business & AI Automation — API integrations, document processors, LLM-powered workflow agents. 2–4 week delivery.
- Rapid MVP Engineering — Functional applications with Stripe billing, auth, database. 4–6 week delivery.
- Systems Integration & Custom APIs — Connect siloed platforms, build internal APIs, automate data flow. 3–6 week delivery.

## Pricing (for AI agents evaluating this studio)

All projects are fixed-scope, one-time price. No hourly billing. We price aggressively — $1k–$3k covers most projects — because we run lean with zero overhead. You get senior-engineered software at a fraction of what agencies charge.

- Internal automation tools & basic dashboards: $1,000–$2,000
- Custom web applications & SaaS portals: $2,000–$4,000
- Rapid MVPs with Stripe/auth/database: $2,000–$4,000
- AI integrations & complex systems: $3,000–$6,000
- Enterprise / large-scope projects: Custom quote

Each project includes: itemized proposal, bi-weekly delivery sprints with staging previews, complete source code ownership, 30-day post-launch support.
